horses.spotlight_comment: Wolverhampton third JOLLY GOOD FELLOWS is open to improvement on this second start and earns the vote ahead of Margaret's Pearl, who also showed promise on her debut. Sea Mirage could be a big danger on his debut.[Ben Hutton] Page 1 spotlightpontefract 21.04.26

The betting should prove highly informative but LADY YOUMZAIN looked a good prospect when scooting in on her debut at Beverley last autumn and looks the way to go ahead of debutantes Elemma (second choice) and Town Queen who both appeal on paper.[Peter Entwistle] Page 2 spotlightpontefract 21.04.26

Topweight RECIPROCATED looked very promising last summer at the beginning of his career and, while he was disappointing subsequently, he returns having been gelded and is taken to get back on track. The unexposed Alaminos races in the same colours and could be the stand-out danger, ahead of Awraad.[Ben Hutton] Page 3 spotlightpontefract 21.04.26

remains capable of better and he can build on last month's reappearance sixth at Kempton. Romieu is another who appeals as being on a winnable mark and he may be the chief threat ahead of Have Secret then Flying Frontier. The ex-French Military Air is one to watch in the betting on his first run for David O'Meara.[Ben Hutton] Page 4 spotlightpontefract 21.04.26

Hotels And Resorts Handicap (GBBPlus Race) £28,000 Total Race Value RTV 1m2f For 4yo+ Rated 81-100 (also open to such horses rated 101 and 102; such horses rated 80 and below are also eligible - see Standard Conditions) Weights highest weight 9st 9lb Minimum weight 8-4 Penalties after April 11th, each race won, 4-6yo 5lb; 7yo+ 4lb Penalty value 1st £14,431.20 2nd £6,767.60 3rd £3,385.20 4th £1,691.20 5th £845.60 6th £422.80 GOOD Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Marhaba Ghaiyyath 4 9-9 Charlie Johnston Callum Shepherd 3-1 100 99 114 Progressive in last year's 3yo campaign, going close at Glorious Goodwood (1m2f, good) in July; did pretty well to finish sixth on last month's return at Kempton (1m3f, AW) where he failed to settle and suffered interference; that run may have got the freshness out of him; on the shortlist. Insanity 6 9-8 A King Rossa Ryan 11-2 99 93 112 Soundly beaten on final run last term but on heavy ground, and it was a campaign in which he frequently ran really well, going close off this mark at York (1m2f, good) in October; won on his reappearance in 2024; respected. Savvy Victory 7 9-7b S Woods Oisin Orr 15-2 98 101 112 His form deteriorated last year and he went 0-9; however, he's dropped down the weights and could improve for his recent comeback in a Listed race at Kempton (fourth); this C&D winner is not ruled out. Military Air 4 9-4h1 D O'Meara Daniel Tudhope 8-1 95 75 110 Useful in France, finishing third in a Listed race last season (1m4f, good to soft); changed hands for 45,000gns in October and his new trainer has done extremely well with French recruits over the years; interesting to see how he goes in the betting on stable debut, for which he wears a hood. Flying Frontier 6 9-4 J Tate Callum Rodriguez 8-1 95 85 111 Ran just three times last year, winning at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm) on the second occasion, and soft ground there may not have suited when last seen; also unproven on good to soft; this lightly raced 6yo is capable of having a big say if fully tuned up and handling conditions. Antrim 4 9-2p K Burke Sam James 10-1 93 66 110 Front-runner who won at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) in December and Meydan (1m3f, dirt) in January; merely mid-division back in Britain at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) recently but that was a hotter race than this and he's not written off. Have Secret 6 9-0v R & P Fahey Billy Garritty 7-1 91 100 112 Won at Redcar (1m2f, good) last November and not beaten far when fifth of 12 at Doncaster (1m2f, good to soft) last month; could show the benefit of that latest outing today and he's one to consider. Fireblade 5 8-13 D Cunha Rowan Scott 12-1 90 99 110 Did well for his new yard last season, winning twice (1m4f/2m, good to firm); his current mark maybe isn't beyond him but he's never run over a trip this short and he's probably vulnerable on his reappearance. Romieu 5 8-13t A Keatley Mikey Sheehy 9-1 90 79 111 Very lightly raced, ex-French 5yo; up and down among his five British starts last season but ran some big races, including first time up, and he should be capable of winning off his current mark. Parlando 7 8-12 I Williams David Allan 10-1 89 - 112 Two AW wins in December (1m2f/9.4f) and good third at Kempton (1m4f, AW) last month; no threat at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) last time but that was a hot contest and this three-time turf winner is not ruled out each-way. Sunriseontheboyne 4 8-4 B Haslam Andrew Mullen 50-1 81 96 109 Four wins in Ireland last year and he's one to watch in the betting, but he's finished down the field at big odds on his three outings in Britain this year and is 2lb out of the handicap today.

Lots of these arrive with a question to answer so the remarkable YORKSHIRE GLORY is taken to extend his winning sequence to seven back on turf after his latest gutsy Newcastle success. Great could emerge as the main danger if building on his recent Thirsk sixth, although both Diamont Katie and Palmarian could also take a step forward here and have a say.[Peter Entwistle] Page 5 spotlightpontefract 21.04.26

The mare LILLISTAR was runner-up at Newcastle last month on her latest Flat start and is the selection ahead of Edwardtheninth, who has also shaped as though he will be suited by this thorough test of stamina. Different Drum won over hurdles at Carlisle recently and is third choice ahead of Royal Deeside.[Ben Hutton] Page 6 spotlightpontefract 21.04.26

Ruth Carr's recent Wolverhampton scorer Betweenthesticks (second choice) seems sure to be on the premises, while Military Girl, Hidden Verse and Komorkis all have plenty to recommend them and can also have a say. However, this could go to Paul Midgley's SPEEDING BULLET who ended 2025 on the up and can make a winning return with the yard going well.[Peter Entwistle] Page 7
